title: Priest tells Vallee to burn an IBM circuit card as 'from the Devil'
summary: Jacques Vallee tells of Priest tells Vallee to burn an IBM circuit card as 'from the Devil', about 1950s-1960s at France, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and he looked at it and he said my son burn it it is from the Devil

plain: Jacques Vallee, a French-born UFO researcher and computer scientist, says that in France, sometime in the 1950s or 60s, a priest was shown an IBM circuit card, a piece of early computer hardware. According to Vallee, the priest looked at it and said, "My son, burn it, it is from the Devil," a story he tells about how new and strange technology can frighten people.
